model.expr: sum by (job, deployment_environment_name, service_version) (artmneme_artworks_creation_failures_total{reason=~"storage|error"} - (artmneme_artworks_creation_failures_total{reason=~"storage|error"} offset 10m or artmneme_artworks_creation_failures_total{reason=~"storage|error"} * 0))

annotations.runbook: 1. Open the dashboard below and check whether the failures are 'storage' or 'error'. 2. Check https://<app>/api/health. 3. storage: check the S3 bucket and the server role (docs/external-services.md > AWS). 4. error: read the app logs on the server (aws ssm start-session, then docker compose logs app in /opt/artmneme). 5. If a new version caused it, roll back: 'Deploy to prod' with the previous image tag.
